name: Latchel MCP
description:
Latchel MCP connects Latchel to AI tools like Claude, giving you instant access to help guides, workflows, and answers without leaving your workflow. Instead of searching manually, simply ask a question and get accurate, Latchel-specific guidance in seconds.

Interact with your Latchel account conversationally.
- Work orders — list them, get full details (including open tasks), review activity history, and create new ones.
- Tasks — list, view details, create, resolve, and reschedule (defer) tasks on a work order.
- Lookups — search your properties, see the residents on a property, and browse your company’s users and user groups.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Latchel MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Latchel MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.latchel.com/mcp/user-tools. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Latchel MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Latchel MCP lists 14 MCP tools, including create_task, create_work_order, defer_task, get_company_user_groups, get_company_users, get_properties, get_residents, get_task_details, get_tasks, get_work_order_details, get_work_order_logs, and get_work_orders.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Latchel MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Latchel MCP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Latchel MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Latchel MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Latchel MCP is developed by Latchel Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
